title: Walmart is selling a $420 Seiko watch for $244, and 'you can feel the quality' - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Reeder ,
13 hours ago
TheStreet aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission.
Why we love this deal No brand does reasonably-priced watches with a luxury feel quite like Seiko. The famed Japanese watchmaker has been selling high-quality timepieces for over a century, and it's not even close to slowing down. At the moment, Walmart is selling one of Seiko's most practical tool watches at a discount during the Walmart Deals promotion. This watch has us very excited, and we think it'll have the same effect on you. Not only is the price right, but it may be the perfect everyday watch.
The Seiko 5 Automatic Field Watch is on sale for only $244 at the moment. With a regular price of $420, this 42% discount is an absolute steal. If you've never had the pleasure of owning a Seiko watch, then this is your sign that today is the day to break that streak.
Seiko 5 Automatic Field Watch, $244 (was $420) at Walmart Courtesy of Walmart
Why do shoppers love it? It would be difficult to find another watch at this price with such a perfect balance of utility, quality, and great looks. As the name would suggest, this is a proper field watch. Its bonafides are evidenced by the 24-hour markings around the dial, luminescent handset and hour marker, and 100 meters of water resistance. All of these make this watch a favorite with military members and outdoors enthusiasts. It has a rugged build and a tough canvas strap that makes it lightweight and comfortable on the wrist.
On the inside, the watch is powered by a highly accurate Seiko automatic movement with 23 jewels. This means that the watch never needs a battery or any sort of recharge. Automatic movements like this one collect power through the motion of your arm. They then store that energy in a mainspring, which releases it throughout the day, allowing the watch to keep accurate time based on pure mechanics and no electronics. What's more, this watch has a clear caseback, which allows you to look inside the watch and see the inner workings of this lovely piece.
With a case diameter of 42 millimeters, the watch is the perfect size for just about any wrist. It's large enough to be legible, but diminutive enough to be considered a "unisex" option by most standards. The case itself is made from rust-resistant 316L stainless steel. It's lightweight yet durable, and looks great as well. Finally, as a convenient addition, the dial has a day and date window at the 3 o'clock position, making it a great everyday wear, no matter if your 9 to 5 is spent on the battlefield, or in your home office.

Details to know Case diameter: 42 millimeters. Movement: Seiko automatic movement. Water resistance: 100 meters. Strap: Lightweight canvas. Walmart shoppers were effusive in their praise of this watch. One said, "Excellent quality for the money. You can feel the quality by the weight of this watch…I've had Casios and Apple watches for years. This is head and shoulders above when it comes to quality."
Shop more deals Seiko Classic Quartz Black Dial Watch, $147 (was $280) at Walmart Seiko Blue Dial Automatic Watch, $154 (was $220) at Walmart Seiko Essentials White Dial Watch, $154 (was $225) at Walmart You won't find a better watch for this price anywhere. For just $244, the Seiko 5 Automatic Field Watch can be on your wrist in mere days. However, the Walmart Deals sale ends on Sunday, Oct. 12, and there's no telling if the price will go back up. Better to be safe than sorry, and put one in your cart now.
